mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% annualized over the previous 3 months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL annualized growth exceeds 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the previous 3 months signals a tightening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where UNRATE decreases by more than 0.5pp.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% over the previous 3 months signals a strengthening demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and thus positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where HOUST increases by more than 5%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the previous 3 months signals increased economic activity, which is positively correlated with S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where INDPRO increases by more than 1%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is increasing, it signals a tightening monetary policy in response to inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4% and CPIAUCSL is increasing.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 over the previous month signals a weakening labor market, which is negatively correlated with S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS decreases by more than 100,000.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 2% over the previous 3 months signals strong consumer demand, which is positively correlated with S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where RSAFS increases by more than 2%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) decreases by more than 0.5% and GDP (GDPC1) growth is positive, it signals accommodative monetary policy supporting economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: accommodative monetary policy with positive GDP growth
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS decreases by more than 0.5% and GDPC1 growth is positive.
